The '''SWE/1 sonic suppressor''' was a model of [[sonic rifle]] produced by [[Telex-Delcor/Legends|Telex-Delcor]] and first released during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The rifle was part of a line of reliable and uncomplicated riot control equipment, and was favored during the war for the fact that the beam it fired could not be parried by a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Telex-Delcor had released a follow-up rifle, the [[SWE/2 sonic rifle/Legends|SWE/2 sonic rifle]].<ref name="FH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The SWE/1 sonic suppressor was first mentioned in ''[[Far Horizons]]'', a reference book for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]] and written by [[Sam Stewart]].
